## Scope

- [ ] This change is bounded to the approved Forge Mission or authorized action.
- [ ] Included and excluded scope are clear.

## Architecture and governance

- [ ] Architecture impact is documented, or explicitly none.
- [ ] Business/Architecture approval evidence is linked where required.
- [ ] Forge, Workspace, and Execution Host boundaries remain intact.

## Validation and quality

- [ ] `bash scripts/validate.sh` passes.
- [ ] TDE status is recorded (or marked not applicable with rationale).
- [ ] Security impact and dependency changes are assessed.

## Operational impact

- [ ] Migration or data impact is documented, or none.
- [ ] Runtime or production action is documented, or none.
- [ ] Rollback approach is documented, or not applicable.

## Documentation and handoff

- [ ] Relevant architecture, roadmap, and bootstrap documentation is current.
- [ ] Handoff/evidence needed by the next operator is included.
